arguments.text: Milestone complete: Stage 2 evaluate(request, evidence, policy) and report.json satisfy the current contract. Actual local boundary checks passed for missing conditions, verification filtering, exact typed condition matching, eligible-only supersession, canonical agreement/disagreement, Boolean false versus zero/null, source-count neutrality, input immutability, exact output fields, and report regeneration. The revised executable model was accepted as 652d4eea59b50465e8dd33152dafe5edf55660ba with all 6 retained cases passing. Remaining limits: malformed/non-JSON inputs, missing or non-string source IDs, and non-JSON-serializable values are outside tested conditions.
